values.failure_policy: Fail closed on serial-gate or ownership drift, unauthenticated or stale identity, capability mismatch, recipient substitution or widening, cross-Polis action, replay, revocation, expiry, policy uncertainty, audit discontinuity or write failure, forbidden-field leakage, zero-test selection, preparation-as-product-proof substitution, or unresolved exact-head findings.
